# Looop

> Looop is an iPhone safety notifications app for families who care from a distance, made by LooopApp LLC in Austin, Texas. It brings holistic family care to the people you love: weather, crime, spending, health, fitness, activity, and the shape of each day come together in one answer, so families know when to check in and loved ones keep their independence. Safety alerts instead of tracking. No ads, ever, and your family's data is never for sale.

Key facts:
- Severe weather alerts in more than 50 countries, including the US, Canada, Mexico, most of Europe, Israel, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea, India, China, the Philippines, Brazil, South Africa, the UAE, and Singapore.
- Nearby crime alerts in all 50 US states, at a distance each family chooses: 1, 3, 5, or 10 miles.
- Unusual Day: one daily answer, a Typical Day or an Unusual Day that might be worth a call.
- Health & Fitness sharing through Apple Health and devices like Apple Watch, Oura, and Whoop, available and optional.
- Optional spending alerts for unusually large charges on a linked account (through Plaid), which can be an early sign of a scam. Looop does not detect or prevent scams.
- Every loved one joins by invitation. Not an emergency service.
- Launched on the App Store in May 2026: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/looop-keep-loved-ones-safe/id6760598111

Who Looop is for: families who care from a distance after the driving years, such as kids at college or in a big city, parents living separately or a few states away, a relative living alone, or siblings and friends who look out for each other.

Looop vs. Life360: Choose Life360 if you want to pay more for precision GPS tracking, driving details recorded and stored, call center support, targeted ads, and your family's data shared with its partners. Choose Looop if you want safety alerts instead of tracking, a nudge when a drive looks unusual, no ads ever, and your family's data never for sale.
